programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When the Black Ink Crew decide to host a charity art show for local kids, Puma and Dutchess bump heads while planning the event. Ceaser sides with Dutchess, leaving the guys in the shop to question his loyalty and business sense. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Krazy with a "K"

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: As the day of reckoning dawns, KP, Tim, Star and Cory are surprised by who shows up at the IAM shop willing to work...and who doesn't. Vudu meets with her biological father for the first time since childhood and is unsure she wants to hear the truth.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: After receiving shocking news regarding the legality of their shop, KP and Tim seek help from KP's dad. Lemeir debuts his new food truck venture and shares concern with Barbie about his fractured relationship with Nessie.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: Bad news abounds as KP and Tim find out the shop failed its health inspection, while Nessie and Barbie learn that Lemeir was in a bad accident. Vudu continues to bond with her father by giving him his first tattoo.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: KP and Tim are disappointed to learn that their artists were at Barbie and Danielle's pop-up shop. During a team tattoo lesson with Cory, Nessie explains how she and the other women in the shop were passed over by KP for a potential client.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: Barbie opens up to Dani about relationship issues and pushes Bone to make amends with her father. After suffering a personal loss, Ink is surprised to find out that Vudu and Nessie quit IAM. At the IAM grand opening, Star drops some big news on KP and Tim

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Los Angeles
programme.desc: KP, Nessie, Lemeir and Star each discuss what went down during pre-COVID filming that led to the current drama. Nessie reveals tension with KP stemming from his unwillingness to hire her ex. Self-promoting at the Pasadena Tattoo Convention causes a rift.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Dutchess reveals a secret to Ceaser that she has kept to herself for weeks. Puma shocks Sassy with big news about him and Quanni. Ted drops a bomb on Ceaser about a pregnant Mixxxy. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Dutchess makes a peace offering at the shop, apologizing for her bad behavior and fills everyone in on her heart condition. Alex confides in her old tattoo artist about her frustrations with the Black Ink crew. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew Dropping the "M" Bomb

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When the woman who brought Ceaser up in the tattoo world visits the shop for a memorial tattoo from Cease, she has some strong opinions about his relationship with Dutchess. Alex and Dutchess finally meet face to face. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The Black Ink Crew is back! Ceaser & Puma's friendship comes to an end when Puma oversteps his boundaries. Dutchess and Ceaser question whether their relationship is strong enough to withstand the stress of Black Ink's newfound success. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When the electric company arrives and pulls the power because Cease hasn't paid the bill, the crew can't work and they are forced to close the shop. Recording artist Erica Mena stops by the shop to have Dutchess cover a tattoo. Presented by VH1.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: In the wake of Sassy's dramatic departure, Ceaser is left to wonder if the joke, and Dutchess' attitude, have gone too far. Alex uncovers some scandalous information about Dutchess online…information that could ruin her reputation. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew No Structure to the Madness

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: With the Black Ink staff dwindling, Ceaser meets with a potential new (female) employee, who is quickly shot down by Dutchess. Puma checks in with Alex and gives her some news that could lead to civil war within the Black Ink Crew. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew These are Minions!

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When Dutchess tells Ceaser the news about Puma's new tattoo shop, he is shocked and hurt by his friend's betrayal. Ceaser tattoos Jadakiss, who gets him thinking about friendship and loyalty. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew The Year of the Puma

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: AIDS activist Maria Davis visits Dutchess at the shop for an HIV/AIDS Awareness tattoo and the entire crew is moved by her inner strength and personal story. After arriving over 4 hours late, Alex makes a dramatic exit from a photo shoot. Presented by VH1
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew You're a Wreck!

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: When Dutchess and Ceaser are hours late for a photo shoot at the shop, the editor of the magazine rips them a new one. When Ceaser confronts Walt about his drinking, Walt reveals some shocking news that will change his future. Presented by VH1.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink Crew I Did Not Sleep With That Women!

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: Intervention
programme.desc: Brian had it all. He married his high school sweetheart, had two beautiful children and became the owner/director of his family's successful funeral home in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: While most 21 olds see a world of possibility in front of them, Jake wakes up every morning despondent at the state of his life--a prisoner to his hoarding and OCD.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: 14 years ago Jason was removed from his mother Augustine's home by Child Protective Services because of her hoarding.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: When rescue workers were called to Judi's home they found her stuck in massive amounts of clutter and were forced to remove her through the kitchen window.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: After the death of her newborn son, Chris filled the void by surrounding herself with possessions.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Bob and Betsey's home is filled with broken furniture, appliances, food, piles of clothes, mounds of books and toys.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Julie is living a nightmare. A series of tragedies triggered massive hoarding which in turn led to Julie's son moving in with her ex-husband.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Deborah, a 49-year-old mother of two is living in fear that her hoarding will lead authorities to take her children away again. Her husband Ron is at his wit's end.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Linda's family has been ripped apart by hoarding.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Janet's picture perfect life crumbled when her husband of 32 years died while waiting for a heart transplant.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Gail's house is literally falling in around her. Gail desperately needs to make repairs but can't because the house is packed full.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Tra is a 40 year-old firefighter living two separate lives. At his firehouse, he is expected to live in a clean and structured world. But in his home, he lives in chaos.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: 28-year-old June lives in a mobile home filled with keepsakes like Care Bears and Cabbage Patch dolls.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: Dennis and his wife Nadene are compulsive hoarders who blame one another for the clutter and mess that has completely consumed their home.
programme.sub-title: Dennis and Nadene / Erin and Malinda

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: This family of 14 was the Brady Bunch of the block--until mother Claudie's hoarding tore the family apart and turned them all into the pariahs of the neighborhood.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: The small paths in Michelle's house are the only way she can get to her collection of more than 60 birds. Her husband of 30 years has been chased from the home by the animals and the hoarded piles that in some places reach five feet high.

programme.title: Hoarders
programme.desc: In this special follow-up episode we check in on the progress of Jill, Jake, Betty, Bill and Paul from our first season.
programme.sub-title: Betty, Jill, Jake and Bill Update

programme.title: La estafa maestra
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionados y abandonados a su suerte en Italia, Charlie Croker y su equipo planean un elaborado robo de oro contra su antiguo aliado.

programme.title: Máxima venganza
programme.desc: En la línea de TRAINING DAY, STREET KINGS y AMERICAN GANGSTER, Curtis 50 CENT Jackson, Val Kilmer y Vinnie Jones protagonizan una nueva película de acción llena de venganza entre policías buenos y malos.

programme.title: Fled: Corre por tu vida

programme.desc: Under the effects of a space/time warp, members of the Tulip's crew find themselves alone in their own parallel universe, dealing with a separate version of their marauding psychopathic prisoner, "Five."

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Bad Girls (REDUX)
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite and his two daughters book the Tulip for a passage to Mars, Percy and the destructive young women become fast friends, creating serious trouble for Dante.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Bad Seed (REDUX)
programme.desc: Dante is abducted by an Orchard agent (Tosca), in an effort to track down Travis. Tosca believes that he is the key to the Divinity Cluster.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Travis (REDUX)
programme.desc: Dante finally finds his son, Travis, but the Raider that raised him stands between father and son reuniting, as the Earth's future hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Resurrection (REDUX)
programme.desc: Eccleston returns from "the other side" just as Raider forces attack the Tulip... on their way to destroy what is left of the Earth.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Rebirth (REDUX)
programme.desc: Percy emerges from hyperspace without Dante or Luc to discover that 15 years have passed. When Percy tries to take legal possession of the Trans-Utopian, she runs into conflict with a starhunter, who is revealed as her cousin Travis, now much older.

programme.title: Lexx: The Dark Zone
programme.desc: A transmission is received advertising a pleasure ship called the Luvliner and Stanley and Xev decide to treat themselves to some R&R. Stanley uses the power of the Lexx to convince the owner to offer some free samples.

programme.title: Lexx: The Dark Zone
programme.desc: The crew of the Lexx encounters an automated TV production facility that makes game shows about people competing in game shows. Everyone has fun until they discover the consequences of having your show canceled.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Secret Agent Man
programme.desc: Felix convinces Oscar to appear on a sports television show against Teddy's advice to stick with radio. NFL Network's Rich Eisen and 'Inside the NBA on TNT's' Kenny Smith guest star as themselves.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Unger Games
programme.desc: When Oscar feels threatened by Felix's surprising performance on the softball field and basketball court, they agree to a decathlon to determine which one of them is the better athlete. Geoff Stults guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Sleeping Dogs Lie
programme.desc: When Oscar and Felix make a trip to Ashley's (Christine Woods) to retrieve Felix's special pillow, a secret that he has kept from Oscar is revealed. Five-time NBA All-Star Chris Webber guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Enlightening Strikes
programme.desc: When Felix substitute teaches a yoga class, his teaching style rubs everyone, including Emily, the wrong way. Weird Al Yankovic and Regis Philbin guest star.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Jealous Island
programme.desc: Oscar becomes obsessed with living up to Murph's (Geoff Stults) standards when he finds out the girl he is seeing used to date the handsome ex-baseball player.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Audit Couple
programme.desc: When the IRS decides to audit Oscar and his ex-wife Gaby, Felix offers to mediate between the contentious exes when he realizes that he might be the reason Oscar was audited in the first place.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: All About Eavesdropping
programme.desc: After Oscar and Felix become obsessed with eavesdropping on their bickering neighbors, they try to subtly intervene and help them save their marriage.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Unger The Influence
programme.desc: With the help of Murph, Oscar decides to throw a big party when Felix finally agrees to spend the weekend away. Also, Felix and Emily have their first sleepover.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: From Here to Maturity
programme.desc: Oscar faces a personal dilemma when he dates a young nanny, Allyson (Brianne Howey) who works for his neighbor, Charlotte (Teri Hatcher).

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Madison & Son
programme.desc: Oscar's dream comes true when he is asked to throw out the first pitch at a New York Mets game.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Oscar's Overture
programme.desc: Oscar attempts to impress Charlotte (Teri Hatcher) by purchasing a table for a fundraiser to benefit The New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: An Oscar Named Desire
programme.desc: Oscar and Charlotte hit a speed bump when they hesitate to take their relationship to the next level.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Make Room For Dani
programme.desc: Oscar reluctantly agrees with his agent that it's time to shake things up on his radio show and allows Dani to have a bigger role after a rival host, Rich Eisen, taunts him.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: A Dinner Engagement
programme.desc: Felix attempts to reverse Emily's birthday curse and plans a nice dinner to celebrate with friends.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Chess Nuts
programme.desc: Oscar learns that Felix was a nationally ranked chess player as a child and convinces him to return to the game to make money.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Odd Man Out
programme.desc: Felix forces Oscar and Emily to go on a date to get to know each other better in the hope that they'll become friends.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Road Scholar
programme.desc: In an attempt to surprise Emily, Felix gets his learner's permit and enlists his friends to help him learn how to drive.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: All The Residents' Men
programme.desc: Oscar and Felix run a heated campaign for President of their building's tenants' association, but Oscar doesn't fully realize everything the position entails.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Ex-Factor
programme.desc: When Murph persuades Oscar to try online dating, Oscar finds himself on a blind date with Felix's ex-wife, Ashley (Christine Woods).

programme.title: The Odd Couple: London Calling
programme.desc: Oscar is forced to choose between his romantic plans with Charlotte (Teri Hatcher) and helping to save Felix's relationship as Emily decides to extend her stay in London.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Food Fight
programme.desc: When Oscar learns that his favorite hangout, Langford's, is in financial trouble, he impulsively asks Felix to help save it, without considering the disastrous consequences.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: I Kid, You Not
programme.desc: Oscar tries to prove to Charlotte that he can be responsible when he volunteers to take her son, Evan (Caleb Brown), trick-or-treating on Halloween.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Taffy Days
programme.desc: Oscar reconnects with many significant people from his father's life when he agrees to carry out Walter's last request to spread his ashes behind the candy factory he once owned.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Miss England
programme.desc: Dani's excitement at being promoted is cut short when Oscar tasks her with the daunting job of hiring her own replacement.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Eisen Trouble
programme.desc: Oscar tries to outsmart his nemesis, Rich Eisen, after he is forced to present him with a humanitarian award.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Odd Couples
programme.desc: Oscar and Felix seek the advice of a counselor in their apartment building to help overcome their issues.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Felix Navidad
programme.desc: When Felix learns that his perfectionist mother Meredith (Jessica Walter) cannot host Christmas this year, he goes into a frenzy as he prepares to take over the Unger family Christmas traditions.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: My Best Friend's Girl
programme.desc: To avoid a night of boredom, Oscar suggests that Charlotte (Teri Hatcher) take Felix out on their artsy cultural dates in his place.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Should She Stay or Should She Go?
programme.desc: Felix meets a fun-loving woman, Natasha (Busy Phillips), in a bar and takes her home for what is meant to be a one-night stand.
programme.sub-title: Should She Stay or Should She Go?

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Batman vs. The Penguin
programme.desc: Murph gets Oscar to agree to participate in a regular TV segment where he competes with a penguin at the zoo to predict the winners of hockey games.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The God Couple
programme.desc: Oscar grumbles when Felix helps Dani prepare for a choir solo and encourages the group to attend church to support her.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Conscious Odd Coupling
programme.desc: After a heated argument, Oscar and Felix decide it might be best to change their living arrangement and find new roommates.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Pilot
programme.desc: Oscar Madison reluctantly agrees to let Felix Unger, his uptight former college roommate, move in with him after both of their marriages fail.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Ghostwriter
programme.desc: When Oscar is hired to ghostwrite the autobiography of a retired baseball player, Felix offers his "help" by advising Murph to go in a different direction, making Oscar's job more difficult. Geoff Stults guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: When Oscar realizes he's forgotten Felix's birthday, he pulls together a last-minute surprise party in his honor in an attempt to impress Casey. Dwight Howard guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Blind Leading The Blind Date
programme.desc: When Dani reveals she's depressed that she'll be the only single one at her high school reunion, Oscar and Felix each put their distinctive dating strategies to work to help her find a boyfriend.
programme.sub-title: The Blind Leading The Blind Date

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Wedding Deception
programme.desc: When Oscar and Felix attend the wedding of an old college friend, Oscar aims to reconnect with an old flame while Felix is determined to show his ex-wife (guest star Christine Woods) that he's a changed man.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Heal Thyself
programme.desc: Felix's hypochondria kicks into overdrive when Oscar starts dating the most important person in Felix's life - his doctor. Erinn Hayes guest stars as Sharon.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Secret Agent Man
programme.desc: Felix convinces Oscar to appear on a sports television show against Teddy's advice to stick with radio. NFL Network's Rich Eisen and 'Inside the NBA on TNT's' Kenny Smith guest star as themselves.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files
programme.desc: Fake celebrity clairvoyant Williams preyed on the elderly by performing fake readings, including one where he directed his client to a forged will.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Stephen Klenczar – Bogus Barrister
programme.desc: Obsessed with boys toys, he posed as a barrister and claimed he worked for the British Government secret service.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Dead End
programme.desc: A young couple hits the road, hitchhiking across North America. Free spirits keen to explore the world. When the young woman stops phoning home, her father is alarmed.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Predator
programme.desc: The phone rings in the middle of the night. On the other end of the line, the sounds of an attack. The couple that receive the call rush to its source and discover a horrific scene.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Lust
programme.desc: One morning in the stairwell of a Toronto building, a guard makes a grotesque discovery: the dead body of a Filipina nanny. It's clear she's been savagely murdered and raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Cold Hit
programme.desc: In 1994, a troubled single mother is found raped and murdered in her apartment. Was it one of the volatile men in her life? All possible suspects are eliminated and the case goes cold for three years, until a nine-year old girl is brutally raped.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Secret Life
programme.desc: In Calgary, Alberta, a beautiful Ethiopian woman is found brutally strangled. The victim’s husband seems genuinely distraught over his wife’s death, but there is something strangely suspicious about him.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hijacked
programme.desc: In 1971, before the era of airport security, a Black Panther hijacks a plane to Havana, Cuba. A thirty-year old cold case is finally solved in 2002 by a fluke of modern technology.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Ordeal of Schoolgirl (Perrais case)
programme.desc: Laetitia Perrais, 18, a trainee hotel waitress, vanishes after evening service.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.
programme.sub-title: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murderous Lovers - Anne Bardot
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of 4 years old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.
programme.sub-title: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Françoise Desnoue Case
programme.desc: On the evening of August 30st 2013, in a small village of Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, 52 years old, reports his wife missing to the police. Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.
programme.sub-title: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.

programme.title: NEW SERIES Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Luka Magnotta confesses to murder online, inspired by Basic Instinct, sparking a manhunt.

programme.title: NEW SERIES Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Jeffrey Dahmer, inspired by The Exorcist III, becomes the infamous Milwaukee Cannibal.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: After a former associate makes it his mission to end the Expendables, Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone) assembles a team of younger, tech-savvy recruits to help take down their enemy.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: To save his teenage son from an unjust prison sentence, a businessman (Dwayne Johnson) makes a deal with a U.S. attorney (Susan Sarandon) to infiltrate a dangerous drug cartel and become an informant.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.title: Sicario
programme.desc: Recruited by Matt Graver, FBI agent Kate Macer joins a task force for the escalating war against drugs. Led by the intense Alejandro, the team travels back-and-forth across the U.S.-Mexican border, using one cartel boss to flush out a bigger one.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: When two young boys are reported missing, a known neighborhood sex offender is the primary suspect.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: The Kids Are Not Alright
programme.desc: Andy has her sights set on a much-needed long weekend. But when a routine highway check leads to the discovery of a teenage boy in the trunk of a car, Andy and Gail must convince him that no heartache lasts forever

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Poison Pill
programme.desc: After a messy drug arrest, Andy and Marlo are quarantined together. Meanwhile, 15 Division springs into emergency response mode in order to get the contaminated drugs off the streets before a deadly outbreak sweeps through the city.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Skeletons
programme.desc: When a young woman is reported missing, the officers of 15 Division soon discover a possible copycat connection to one of their division’s most distressing cases. With the clock ticking, Gail must face her worst fears..

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: When human bones found in a ravine open up a 15-year-old missing persons case, Swarek reunites with his old training officer to solve the case

programme.title: Rookie Blue: For Better, For Worse
programme.desc: Everyone at 15 Division, especially Andy, just wants a quick, smooth shift so they can get to Frank and Noelle’s wedding. But things get complicated when they get called to a hijacked casino bus full of senior citizens

programme.title: Rookie Blue: What I Lost
programme.desc: When Chris returns for a visit, his reunion takes a shocking turn when his son, Christian, is abducted while under the care of Andy and Nick

programme.title: Rookie Blue: You Are Here
programme.desc: Near the end of shift, 15 Division busts a marijuana grow-op – a case that becomes Traci’s first homicide and forces Andy, Nick and Gail to work overtime

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Deception
programme.desc: When a suspected pedophile is found beaten within an inch of his life, Andy discovers Marlo has been conducting a mania-fueled, off-hours “investigation”

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Under Fire
programme.desc: After Andy and Chloe take fire from an unseen shooter, the officers realize they are the targets of someone with a grudge against 15 Division

programme.title: Rookie Blue: You Can See the Stars
programme.desc: In the wake of a targeted attack on the officers of 15 Division (ep. 412), Andy, Swarek, and their fellow officers have to piece together the truth about a past crime in order to find Oliver Shaw – in time to save his life

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Blink
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the night’s traumatic events, Andy and Dov try to pull themselves together at an all-night diner, but are caught off-duty and off-guard in a volatile diner hold-up.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: Grissom and his team investigate a string of murders in Las Vegas that may be tied to an infamous mob boss from the 1970s who disappeared many years ago.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: All by Her Selfie
programme.desc: Oliver gets promoted and Andy is tasked with training 15 Division’s newest rookie, Duncan Moore. But when Andy and Duncan respond to a messy homicide at a pawnshop, it’s clear this rookie is going to give Andy the challenge of a lifetime.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Heart Breakers, Money Makers
programme.desc: When Andy and Nick’s seizure at an illegal gambling house leads to a suspicious confession, Andy recruits Sam to help figure out who’s lying, why, and where the money is, before anyone gets hurt.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: The CIA promises Kane that killing a notorious organ trafficker will bring Kane one step closer to The Ghost.

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Bojan, a ghost from Kane’s past resurfaces and the CIA believes Bojan is in town to protect The Ghost’s personal money launderer - who is also coming to town.

programme.desc: Principios del siglo 18. El cartógrafo Cartographer Jonathan Green emprende un viaje científico por Europa hacia el este. Luego de pasar por Transilvania y habiendo cruzado los Montes Cárpatos, se encuentra en una pequeña villa perdida en los bosques.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Clara y su familia se mudan a una pequeña casa en la zona rural de Hinsdale, Nueva York, se dan cuenta de que la paz de la vida en el campo es simplemente una ilusión y la amenaza de muerte es muy real.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En Maryland, la casa de Kathie Sheats, una madre soltera, es acosada por un demonio. Los psíquicos, los sacerdotes y los investigadores paranormales no logran resolver el problema.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Chris Gibbons y su familia se mudan a la casa de sus sueños... que se convierte en una pesadilla. Una extraña combinación de sueños aterradores y avistamientos de fantasmas obligan a Chris a luchar contra lo sobrenatural.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En Michigan, la familia Johnson encuentra la que creen su casa perfecta, pero resulta estar embrujada y un demonio intenta poseer a su hijo. Sólo el poder de la oración puede devolver la paz y la cordura.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Jamie y Aaron, nativos de Carolina del Norte, viven un estilo de vida sureño "perfecto"... hasta que una entidad oscura comienza a aterrorizar a sus hijos. A riesgo de exponerse a las burlas, contactan a expertos paranormales para que los rescaten.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Bob Baker, un investigador paranormal de Connecticut, pide ayuda a sus colegas y a un obispo porque la casa de su madre está embrujada. Como no logran limpiar la casa, Bob tiene que recurrir a su propio pasado "embrujado" para hacer el trabajo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La familia VanLandingham se muda a Arkansas y sus jóvenes hijas sufren un ataque sobrenatural de entidades oscuras. Los esfuerzos de un Pastor y un investigador paranormal para liberarlas son en vano, así que deciden abandonar la casa de sus sueños.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La histórica Casa de los Allen, en Arkansas, está encantada. Mark y Rebecca Spencer lo sabían cuando la compraron. Investigan la causa del embrujo, descubren el pasado secreto de la casa y a un anterior propietario que se suicidó.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Lynn y Jason Ryder compran un histórico restaurante en Connecticut, pero son invadidos por las fuerzas del mal y empleados y clientes son atacados. Investigadores, médiums y clarividentes son llamados para librar al restaurante de su pasado demoníaco.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cindy Sauer intenta superar la repentina muerte de su marido cuando sombras oscuras y pesadillas la convencen de que un demonio la persigue a ella y a su familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Victoria Dane, de Nuevo México, despierta de una experiencia cercana a la muerte y descubre que está siendo atacada por una entidad demoníaca.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un hombre se enamora de una mujer casada y le arranca un mechón de amenazándola con lanzarle un hechizo para alejarla de su marido. Poco después, un espíritu demoníaco comienza a aterrorizar a la pareja

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Mark Corvo tiene un don espiritual que podría costarle la vida. Regresa a vivir en la casa de su infancia y allí se enfrenta a fuerzas oscuras que intentan matarlo. Los investigadores paranormales descubren que se ha abierto un portal en la casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un adolescente incursiona en el ocultismo y un espíritu maligno aterroriza a toda la familia en su nuevo hogar.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Edwin González y Lillian Otero creían haber encontrado la casa de sus sueños, pero pronto se convierte en una pesadilla. Todo cambia tras la aparición de un ser. Lillian es poseída por un espíritu maligno y atacada violentamente.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Dos entidades vagan por una granja de 200 años de antigüedad, aterrorizando a la familia que vive allí; pero están decididos a quedarse en la casa, aumentando la actividad paranormal a niveles amenazantes.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Dos hermanos se encuentran con una entidad demoníaca en los bosques alrededor de su casa en Florida y se enfrentan a ella décadas después.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una entidad oscura se despierta en una mansión del siglo XIX; la familia Rice experimenta una aterradora persecución y finalmente tiene que abandonar la casa de sus sueños.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: John Drenner, Jr. encuentra una biblia satánica y, sin saberlo, desata un demonio implacable que no se detendrá ante nada para destruirlo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La casa de ensueño de una familia se convierte en su pesadilla cuando se manifiesta un fantasma abusivo. Ante la violencia del ente, buscan a una empática y descubren la oscura historia de la propiedad.

programme.title: Mis Tres Viudas Alegres
programme.desc: México, años 50. En plena noche de bodas con su esposa Silvia, el viejo sabio José se muere. Aparecen otras viudas suyas, la cubana Amalia y la francesa Lilia. El les deja 60 millones de pesos a estas a cambio de que encuentren a un hijo.

programme.title: Piernas De Oro
programme.desc: En una carrera de bicicletas, Clavillazo vence a Esteban quien siempre había sido el campeón municipal. El coronel García ordena que formen una cuarteta con Clavillazo. Esteban y otros, para correr en la vuelta al centro de la república.

programme.title: Platillos Voladores
programme.desc: Marciano y Saturnina, van a un baile de disfraces con trajes interplanetarios. Al producirse una pelea entre el joven y un pretendiente de la muchacha a quien apoya su padre, la pareja escapa en un artefacto inventado por Marciano que es mecánico.

programme.title: Pobre Huerfanita
programme.desc: Virginia es una niña que lo tiene todo en la vida, menos el cariño de su padre que por tener tanto dinero se la viven de fiesta en fiesta, por lo que le brindan muy poco a casi nada de atención quedando siempre al cuidado de una institutriz.

programme.title: Que Hombre Tan Sin Embargo
programme.desc: Filomeno, es un hombre que llega a casa de Laura cuando mas lo necesita. El es un simple desconocido para Laura y su familia adinerada y de prestigio que por el momento pasa por una crisis financiera, ya que la industria de la sal estan en quiebra.

programme.title: Que Lindo Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: El diablo, molesto porque Don Candido, el presidente municipal de un pueblo esta moralizando las costumbres del pueblo que gobierna, envia a uno de sus subordinados a la tierra para corromper el ambiente mediante la organizacion de un cabaret.

programme.title: Recien Casados... No Molestar
programme.desc: Catalina y Andres son una joven pareja a punto de casarse. Cada uno tiene su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y amigas respectivamente, donde intentan hacerles ver los pros y los contras del matrimonio con un poco de satira.

programme.title: Rumba Caliente
programme.desc: Ticha es una joven cuyo trabajo es ser vendedora de cigarros y dulces en el teatro, con el sueño de triunfar como actriz y ser como la Vedette Lily del mar quien trabaja en una de las obras exhibidas en el teatro.

programme.title: Santo Vs El Estrangulador
programme.desc: Cosas extrañas suceden en el teatro de una localidad donde se presentan diversas obras musicales, ya que alguien ha estado matando a varias bailarinas y actrices de dichas obras.

programme.title: Si Volvieras A Mi
programme.desc: Pedro cuenca, medico de profesión, se muda con su amigo y colega el doctor montes roca para llevar a cabo su ano de residencia como médico rural. Allí conoce a la hija de su anfitrión, la bella Alejandra.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las niñas asiáticas de la escuela están dibujando imágenes románticas al estilo manga de Tweek y Craig, creando una gran confusión entre los alumnos y los padres.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras Kenny y los chicos juegan a ser ninjas, todos en South Park empiezan a creer que en realidad forman parte de una organización terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC está extremadamente furioso con uno de sus alumnos, Jimmy Valmer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC desaparece con dos estudiantes de cuarto grado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La desconfianza entre Kyle y Stan ha roto su amistad, y Kyle se ha arrojado en una peligrosa alianza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Himno Nacional estadounidense es modificado por J.J. Abrams. Mientras tanto, el Sr. Garrison intenta lanzar las Elecciones Presidenciales contra Hillary Clinton.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos deciden que tienen que acabar con Cartman porque están convencidos de que él es el Troll. Mientras tanto, el padre de Kyle logra mantener en secreto su identidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A medida que continúa su asedio virtual a todos, Gerald está encantado con la atención de los medios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se unen para protestar por sus derechos mostrando algunas partes de sus cuerpos sin ropa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gran Basura desiste de la carrera por la presidencia. Mientras tanto, Gerald (CazaPutas42) lucha con los demás Trolls para detener el movimiento antitroll de Dinamarca.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una ciudad entera en Colorado es hackeada. Gerald y Cartman pueden perderlo todo cuando la historia de su actividad en Internet se hace pública.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gerald se encuentra cara a cara con el Cazador de Trolls. Cartman teme que Heidi descubra su pasado. El director PC intenta lograr la paz entre los chicos y las chicas de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Garrison, que recientemente recibió la apariencia de Donald Trump, ha sido electo como nuevo presidente de los Estados Unidos. Gerald intenta escapar del temido cazador de trolls danés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman está seguro de que Butters está intentando robarle a su novia.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman intenta convencer a los científicos de que ir a Marte es una mala idea. Kyle y Ike desafían a su mamá e intentan, junto con todos los chicos, salvar al mundo de una destrucción segura.
programme.sub-title: El fin de la serialización tal como la conocemos

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman está cansado de su novia Heidi y comienza a enamorarse de Alexa, una inteligencia artificial. Mientras tanto, Randy y Sharon Marsh lanzan un programa de televisión en donde remodelan casas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Corea del Norte apunta sus misiles hacia South Park. Mientras tanto, en la escuela hay una nueva campaña para incentivar el uso consciente del celular y Cartman inicia una campaña contra el suicidio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy hará de todo para probar que tiene ADN de los nativos americanos en su cuerpo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Coon y Amigos regresan con el pretencioso plan de ganar dinero con una franquicia de películas de superhéroes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Es Halloween y los hombres de South Park celebran su encuentro anual del Día de las Brujas. Pero al leer un libro de hechizos, uno de ellos se convierte en un brujo de verdad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le echa la culpa de su mal humor a la comida chatarra y Heidi le propone iniciar una dieta juntos. Mientras, Kyle no entiende el motivo por el cual Cartman todavía quiere salir con Heidi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El proyecto de Jimmy y Timmy puede ganar el primer premio en la feria anual de ciencias, y Nathan y Mimsy quieren sabotearlos. Mientras tanto, la relación de Heidi y Cartman es cada vez más abusiva.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC se enamora de la nueva vice-directora de la escuela. Mientras tanto, Terrance y Phillip quieren firmar un contrato con Netflix, y Kyle está cansado de ser humillado por Heidi y Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los adultos de South Park están enojados ya que el presidente está asustando a sus hijos. Los niños parten con el fin de desentrañar el gran misterio de Garrison al estilo It y Stranger Things.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy está desesperado por ayudar a Sharon a controlar sus emociones y Cartman reprueba inesperadamente su examen de matemáticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Se ha desarrollado una relación muy especial entre Butters y el sacerdote de su parroquia.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El comportamiento ofensivo del Sr. Mojón lo pone en riesgo de ser despedido como director del espectáculo anual de Navidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butters está vendiendo vaporizadores y todo tipo de sabores frutados en la escuela. Randy decide que debería mudar a la familia al campo y dedicarse a la agricultura.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños planean usar la última revolución en movilidad para obtener más dulces durante la Noche de Brujas de los que obtuvieron antes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos de South Park están en peligro y los niños descubren que solo Al Gore puede ayudarlos.
programme.sub-title: Es hora de tomarlo en cereal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos salen de la cárcel y huyen de la policía y del Hombre-Oso-Cerdo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha sido diagnosticado con ansiedad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es elegida para ser la sede del nuevo Centro de Distribución de Amazon.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La posibilidad de que los chicos ganen el desfile de bicis está en peligro cuando Kenny se retira.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy lucha contra la producción casera de mariguana. Kyle va a un centro de detención.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy ve una oportunidad para Tegridad en China.

programme.title: Invasión Final
programme.desc: Un asesino condenado y un piloto son los malvados alienígenas que toman el control de viajeros de aerolínea extraviada.

programme.title: Los hijos del diablo
programme.desc: Una familia se muda a una zona rural sin saber que detrás de la belleza de los bosques se esconden criaturas demoníacas.

programme.title: Los rostros del diablo

programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: Calígula
programme.desc: Detalla la historia impactante, pero innegablemente trágica, del césar más infame de Roma, Calígula.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: Siempre Alice
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Julianne Moore), 2014. La doctora Alice Howland es una profesora casada y madre de 3 hijos, no da importancia a los pequeños lapsus hasta que debe comenzar a luchar para seguir siendo Alice.

programme.title: Viaje a Italia
programme.desc: Steve Coogan y Rob Brydon reciben el encargo de un nuevo viaje gastronómico, esta vez por Italia. Estos dos improbables amigos conducen por todo el país mientras vuelven a discutir sobre la vida, el amor y el cine.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 1
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 2
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Pompeya
programme.desc: Un gladiador intenta salvar a su amada mientras un volcán entra en erupción y lo llena todo de lava y ceniza.

programme.title: 1492: La conquista del paraíso
programme.desc: Retrata la vida del atrevido explorador Cristóbal Colón. Un difícil y sorprendente viaje hasta una tierra desconocida por el mundo, América; el efecto sobre las tribus indígenas y la vuelta del héroe a España hasta su muerte.

programme.title: El ladrón de Shanghai
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de un maestro en artes marciales, un intrépido joven se hace pasar por un príncipe llegado de un lejano país para poder casarse con la hija del Rey y aspirar al trono.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Un guardaespaldas de élite "retirado", Zhang Han, une fuerzas con su ex compañero para salvar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: Mentira de familias

programme.title: Tracers

programme.title: El mensajero

programme.title: Rush

programme.sub-title: La Sala de Escape de la Prisión de Baumettes (Pierre Folacci)

programme.desc: Alrededor de las 11 de la noche, se llama a la policía para un asalto en un estacionamiento en el bosque de Saint-Lambert-des-Bois.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Drost Notthoff
programme.desc: El 11 de septiembre de 2011, en Èze, cerca de Mónaco, el propietario de una villa de lujo descubre el cuerpo colgado sin vida de su inquilino.

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: La familia Manson
programme.desc: Dianne, una adolescente de 14 años, es seducida por la "familia" de Charles Manson. Dianne ve cómo su filosofía hippie de paz y amor se vuelve algo oscuro, peligroso y malvado. ¿Cómo sobrevivir a uno de los asesinos más enigmáticos de la historia?

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: El asesino Playboy
programme.desc: Como compañera de casa de Paul Snider, Patti ve el devastador efecto que tiene en él la ruptura con su esposa, la Playmate de Playboy Dorothy Stratten, sobre su ego frágil. Cuando Paul pierde el control, destruye la vida de Dorothy y la carrera de Patti.

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: Sammy "el Toro" Gravano
programme.desc: Karen es la orgullosa hija de Sammy el Toro, un mafioso poderoso de Nueva York. Todo se derrumba cuando Sammy testifica para el gobierno y cambia la historia del crimen organizado de Nueva York. Pero no pensó en el impacto en la vida de su hija.

programme.title: Proyecto Serpo
programme.desc: 2005: Ex agente revela un informe de 3.000 páginas sobre una misión secreta de intercambio ET al planeta Serpo

programme.title: Archivos Gubernamentales de OVNIs Desclasificados
programme.desc: Los gobiernos guardan secretos. ¿Pero qué ocurre cuando estos secretos ya no pueden ser encubiertos más?

programme.title: Fotografías Auténticas de un Extraterrestre: El Caso Caponi
programme.desc: Los encuentros de Caponi con extraterrestres de 1993. Las fotos reales muestran vida extraterrestre.

programme.title: Linda Napolitano: La Abducción Alienígena del Siglo
programme.desc: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

programme.title: El Accidente OVNI en Roswell
programme.desc: Encubrimientos y conspiraciones... ¿Qué sucedió realmente esa noche en Roswell, en 1947?

programme.title: Roswell: La Verdad No Revelada
programme.desc: El comandante Jesse Marcel investiga extraños escombros encontrados en 1947, a pesar de que le dijeron que era un globo meteorológico.

programme.title: Los Testigos: Encuentros con Antiguos Alienígenas
programme.desc: El contactado, el vidente y el abducido comparten experiencias similares y diferentes con seres de otras dimensiones, dejando una marca duradera de su presencia.

programme.title: Ingenieros Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Nuestra evolución puede estar influenciada por nuestros antepasados y sus dioses. No estamos solos en el universo.

programme.title: Alienígenas: Los Encuentros Esotéricos
programme.desc: Las historias teosóficas de Madame Blavatsky, los relatos sobre demonios Jinn, y la vida de Maria Orsic narran dimensiones en las cuales, a través de la espiritualidad y el esoterismo, es posible establecer contacto con alienígenas

programme.title: Encuentros Extraterrestres: Los Grises
programme.desc: ¿Quiénes son los alienígenas grises y cuál es su interés en nuestro mundo? En este documental exploramos los posibles motivos detrás de tres de los encuentros más prolíficos en nuestra historia.

programme.title: OVNIs Nazis
programme.desc: Se rumorea que la Alemania Nazi desarrolló naves espaciales avanzadas y que científicos continuaron en bunkers en la Antártida y Sudamérica. Sin evidencia, la teoría mezcla esoterismo y restauración nazi paranormal.

programme.title: Señales de OVNIs en la Historia Humana
programme.desc: Gracias a la extensa investigación realizada por el erudito Ivan Ceci, hemos descubierto numerosos avistamientos de OVNIs que datan desde el 300 a.C. hasta la actualidad. Este notable hallazgo fue posible gracias a una minuciosa investigación.

programme.title: La Verdad Oculta
programme.desc: Con el investigador Pier Giorgio Caria, exploramos desde los primeros contactos con razas extraterrestres hasta los retos geopolíticos actuales, buscando un despertar y contacto colectivo con nuestros hermanos estelares.

programme.title: OVNI: Primer Contacto
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en avistamientos de OVNIs y encuentros cercanos que involucran aeronaves comerciales y militares, trayéndoles los relatos más asombrosos de pilotos que han presenciado objetos voladores no identificados durante sus vuelos.

programme.title: [rec]
programme.desc: Una reportera está haciendo un reportaje en una estación de bomberos. Atrapados en el interior de un edificio, los bomberos y el equipo de televisión tendrán que enfrentarse a algo siniestro y maligno, esconderse y tratar desesperadamente de escapar.

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: La Senda
programme.desc: En un intento por salvar su matrimonio, Raúl decide pasar las Navidades con su familia en una cabaña aislada en medio de la nieve. Durante la Nochebuena todo parece marchar bien, pero, de repente, la situación da un giro totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: La relación de Alex y Evan toma un giro diferente a medida que ambos comienzan de nuevo. Kelly da un salto hacia lo desconocido y Christian propone a Chloe, el nuevo jefe de Miranda, con una canción.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Kelly tiene la mejor noche de su vida, mientras que Alex y Rex tienen una de las más difíciles. Evan se sumerge en el mundo publicitario.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: Oscuras intenciones
programme.desc: Molly is struggling with being a new mom, but after meeting Beth, things temporarily improve only to turn as Beth's dark intentions are brought to light.

programme.title: A pleno sol
programme.desc: Tom Ripley es un prodigioso impostor, gorrón, falsificador y delincuente de la improvisación en general

programme.title: La muerte y la doncella
programme.desc: En un país imaginario que acaba de sufrir una terrible dictadura, viven Paulina Escobar y su marido Gerardo, un prestigioso abogado. Una noche, Gerardo tiene una avería con su coche, pero un hombre se ofrece a ayudarle…

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: El detective Jacob King se desplaza a Memphis para seguir el rastro de dos asesinos en serie. Cada hallazgo de un cadáver es un nuevo mazazo en la conciencia de Jacob, que deberá encontrar a los asesinos antes de que la cuenta de muertes siga en aumento.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Sunshine Exprésate
programme.desc: Elida deja el equipo para tomar un trabajo de carroñero mientras Isaac y Amae luchan contra los secuestradores en un tren.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Sin pistas
programme.desc: A la deriva en el espacio, el equipo se encuentra en medio de un misterioso asesinato muy extraño.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Todo lo viejo debe perecer - Parte 1
programme.desc: El equipo llega a Arriopa para derribar a Lázaro. Un rostro del pasado regresa inesperadamente.
programme.sub-title: Todo lo viejo debe perecer - Parte 1

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Todo lo viejo debe perecer - Parte 2
programme.desc: Arriopa está sumida en el caos. Elida hace un último empujón para detener a Lázaro, pero surge una nueva e impactante amenaza.
programme.sub-title: Todo lo viejo debe perecer - Parte 2

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Después de quedar varado cerca de un agujero negro, el capitán Dylan Hunt es descubierto por un barco de salvamento mercenario y descubre que ha estado congelado en el tiempo durante 300 años.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan protege a la Andrómeda de los mercenarios mientras Beka comienza a preguntarse si están luchando por el lado equivocado.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Aflojando el Fatídico Relámpago
programme.desc: Dylan encuentra una estación espacial llena de niños que creen que está allí para traer la paz matando a sus enemigos.

programme.title: Andrómeda: D Menos Cero
programme.desc: La tripulación de Andrómeda todavía está aprendiendo a trabajar juntos mientras son atacados por los Restauradores.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Doble Hélice
programme.desc: La Andrómeda se involucra en una disputa entre un planeta Than y una colonia Nietzschean.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Ángel Oscuro, Demonio Brillante
programme.desc: Una corriente de deslizamiento envía a la Andrómeda de vuelta en el tiempo a justo antes de que cayera la Mancomunidad. La tripulación debe intervenir para preservar la historia.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Los Lazos que Atan
programme.desc: Responder a una llamada de socorro lleva a la tripulación a recoger al hermano de Beka, ahora un Wayist, y a su amigo.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Los Bancos del Leteo
programme.desc: Un agujero negro permite a Dylan comunicarse con su ex prometida, 300 años en el pasado.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Una Rosa en las Cenizas
programme.desc: Dylan es encarcelado en un planeta carcelario y debe organizar una fuga mientras su tripulación intenta organizar su propio rescate.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Todo el Océano del Gran Neptuno
programme.desc: Los Castalians abordan el Andrómeda para finalizar la carta de la Nueva Mancomunidad. Cuando el líder es descubierto muerto, Tyr es el principal sospechoso.
programme.sub-title: Todo el Océano del Gran Neptuno

programme.title: Andrómeda: Las Perlas Que Fueron Sus Ojos
programme.desc: Beka se entera de que el ex socio de negocios de su padre se ocupa de una droga altamente adictiva llamada Flash.
programme.sub-title: Las Perlas Que Fueron Sus Ojos

programme.title: Andrómeda: Las Matemáticas de las Lágrimas
programme.desc: La Andrómeda descubre su nave hermana, la Pax Magellanic. La tripulación a bordo del Pax tiene 300 años, pero no ha envejecido ni un día.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Música de un Tambor Distante
programme.desc: Tyr se estrella contra el Eureka Maru en un planeta Nietzschean y desarrolla amnesia. Debe recordar lo que está haciendo antes de que los Nietzscheans lo descubran a él y a su caja de bienes robados.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper recibe el don del conocimiento de un Perseid moribundo, sólo para descubrir que el Perseid estaba siendo buscado por un cazarrecompensas que ahora ha vuelto su atención a Harper.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Perspectiva Forzada
programme.desc: Dylan fue arrestado por asesinar a un dictador hace 300 años.

programme.title: Andrómeda: La Suma de Sus Partes
programme.desc: Andrómeda está embarcada por un dron del Consenso de Partes, una sociedad mecánica mítica. Mientras que amistoso al principio, el dron intenta forzar a la nave a unirse al Consenso.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Elsa & Fred
programme.desc: In New Orleans, a feisty retiree (Shirley MacLaine) and her new neighbor, an uptight widower (Christopher Plummer), discover that it's never too late for true love and romance.

programme.title: A Little Bit of Heaven
programme.desc: New Orleans ad executive Marley Corbett (Kate Hudson) is a free-spirited woman who embraces her easy sexuality, shuns commitment, and gains support and strength from a close circle of friends. Then Marley learns she has terminal colon cancer. Despite her determination not to be tied down in a serious relationship, Marley finds herself falling in love with her handsome doctor (Gael García Bernal), even as her health slowly deteriorates.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Col. Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) is a 30-year Marine veteran: a decorated officer with combat experience in Vietnam, Beirut and Desert Storm -- a patriot, a hero. But now, the country he served so well has put him on trial for a rescue mission that went terribly wrong. For his attorney, he has chosen Marine Col. Hays Hodges (Tommy Lee Jones), a comrade-in-arms who owes his life to Childers.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.
